title: General denominator identity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ have positive total influence $I(f)$. For real numbers $\epsilon,\eta>0$ and an integer $k\ge0$, set $\rho=\eta/(2+\eta)$, $T=((\epsilon/I(f))\rho^k)^{1+\eta}$, and $C=(2/\eta+1)^{1+\eta}$. Then $$\frac{I(f)}{T}=\frac{I(f)^{2+\eta}}{\epsilon^{1+\eta}C^k}.$$
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube to the signs
The total influence of $f$ is positive
